status: IMPLEMENTATION CONTRACT derived from frozen Design 1 v1.1
rules: Exactly one official water route is assigned for each valid routable structure/run.
Validation readiness does not silently reroute a structure to another water route.
If route-defining identity/timing/rejuvenation inputs are unresolved, official water route remains null and route decision is unresolved.
Workbook-level not-ready status withholds official routing truth.
HOLD and excluded routes are official controlled terminal routes.
KPI 1.2.1 person-day routing is parallel and independent from water-route readiness.
Engine 5 does not calculate water volume or person-days.
